void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes<T>(T[] items, T value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

int total(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    hundredths := if denominator == 0 then 0 else numerator * 100 / denominator
    return string(hundredths / 100) + "." + (if hundredths % 100 < 10 then "0" else "") + string(hundredths % 100)

int numeric(string text, int low, int high)
    if #text == 0 or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return -1
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return -1
    value := int(text)
    return if low <= value <= high then value else -1

class Point(int x, int y)
class Position(state := 0, x := 4, y := 22)
class Motion(bool success, Position position, kick_test := 0)
class Candidate(int value, string kind, string[] operations)
class SearchNode(Position position, string[] operations)

Position spawn_position(string kind)
    return Position(0, if kind == "O" then 5 else 4, 22)

Point[] cells(string kind, Position position)
    string[] rows := []
    if kind == "I"
        rows = ["....", "####", "....", "...."]
    elif kind == "O"
        rows = ["##", "##"]
    elif kind == "T"
        rows = [".#.", "###", "..."]
    elif kind == "S"
        rows = [".##", "##.", "..."]
    elif kind == "Z"
        rows = ["##.", ".##", "..."]
    elif kind == "J"
        rows = ["#..", "###", "..."]
    else
        rows = ["..#", "###", "..."]
    Point[] result := []
    size := int(#rows)
    for: j < size
        for: i < size
            if rows[j][i] != "#"
                continue
            px := i
            py := j
            for: rotation < position.state
                old_x := px
                px = size - 1 - py
                py = old_x
            result = result.append(Point(position.x + px, position.y - py))
    return result

int lowest(string kind, Position position)
    result := 22
    for cell := cells(kind, position)[]
        result = minimum(result, cell.y)
    return result

string state_name(int state)
    return ["0", "R", "2", "L"][state]

int clear_index(int spin, int count)
    return if spin == 1 then 4 + count elif spin == 2 then 7 + count else count - 1

string clear_name(int index)
    return ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "TETRIS", "TSPIN_MINI", "TSPIN_MINI_SINGLE", "TSPIN_MINI_DOUBLE", "TSPIN", "TSPIN_SINGLE", "TSPIN_DOUBLE", "TSPIN_TRIPLE"][index]

class Well()
    bool[][] rows := array(22, fill = array(10, fill = false))

    bool blocked(int column, int row)
        return column < 1 or column > 10 or row < 1 or row > 22 or rows[row - 1][column - 1]

    bool fits(string kind, Position position)
        for cell := cells(kind, position)[]
            if blocked(cell.x, cell.y)
                return false
        return true

    bool grounded(string kind, Position position)
        return not fits(kind, Position(position.state, position.x, position.y - 1))

    Position landing(string kind, Position position)
        result := position
        while not grounded(kind, result)
            result.y -= 1
        return result

    int .place(string kind, Position position)
        for cell := cells(kind, position)[]
            rows[cell.y - 1][cell.x - 1] = true
        bool[][] kept := []
        for row := rows[]
            if includes(row, false)
                kept = kept.append(row)
        cleared := 22 - int(#kept)
        while #kept < 22
            kept = kept.append(array(10, fill = false))
        rows = kept
        return cleared

    bool empty()
        for row := rows[]
            if includes(row, true)
                return false
        return true

    bool .garbage(int count, int hole)
        for: 22 - count <= row < 22
            if includes(rows[row], true)
                return false
        garbage_row := [for column := (1:<11)[] then column != hole]
        rows = array(nat(count), fill = garbage_row).concat(rows[:<22 - count])
        return true

    int[] metrics()
        heights := array(10, fill = 0)
        holes := 0
        bumpiness := 0
        for: column < 10
            for: row < 22
                if rows[row][column]
                    heights[column] = row + 1
            for: row < heights[column]
                if not rows[row][column]
                    holes += 1
            if column > 0
                bumpiness += absolute(heights[column] - heights[column - 1])
        return heights.append(holes).append(bumpiness)

    int evaluation(int cleared)
        int[] measurements := metrics()
        return 76 * cleared - 51 * total(measurements[:<10]) - 36 * measurements[10] - 18 * measurements[11]

    Motion movement(string kind, Position position, string operation)
        if operation == "CW" or operation == "CCW"
            after := (position.state + (if operation == "CW" then 1 else 3)) % 4
            transitions := [1, 4, 6, 9, 11, 14, 12, 3]
            key := position.state * 4 + after
            row := 0
            while transitions[row] != key
                row += 1
            int[][] offsets := []
            if kind == "I"
                offsets = [[0, 0, -2, 0, 1, 0, -2, -1, 1, 2], [0, 0, 2, 0, -1, 0, 2, 1, -1, -2], [0, 0, -1, 0, 2, 0, -1, 2, 2, -1], [0, 0, 1, 0, -2, 0, 1, -2, -2, 1], [0, 0, 2, 0, -1, 0, 2, 1, -1, -2], [0, 0, -2, 0, 1, 0, -2, -1, 1, 2], [0, 0, 1, 0, -2, 0, 1, -2, -2, 1], [0, 0, -1, 0, 2, 0, -1, 2, 2, -1]]
            else
                offsets = [[0, 0, -1, 0, -1, 1, 0, -2, -1, -2], [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 2, 1, 2], [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 2, 1, 2], [0, 0, -1, 0, -1, 1, 0, -2, -1, -2], [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -2, 1, -2], [0, 0, -1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 2, -1, 2], [0, 0, -1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 2, -1, 2], [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -2, 1, -2]]
            attempts := if kind == "O" then 1 else 5
            for: i < attempts
                target := Position(after, position.x + offsets[row][2 * i], position.y + offsets[row][2 * i + 1])
                if fits(kind, target)
                    return Motion(true, target, i + 1)
            return Motion(false, position)
        dx := if operation == "L" or operation == "LL" then -1 elif operation == "R" or operation == "RR" then 1 else 0
        dy := if dx == 0 then -1 else 0
        target := position
        success := false
        while true
            next := Position(target.state, target.x + dx, target.y + dy)
            if not fits(kind, next)
                break
            success = true
            target = next
            if operation == "L" or operation == "R" or operation == "SD"
                break
        return Motion(success, target)

    int spin(Position position, int kick_test)
        bool[] corners := [blocked(position.x, position.y), blocked(position.x + 2, position.y), blocked(position.x + 2, position.y - 2), blocked(position.x, position.y - 2)]
        count := 0
        for corner := corners[]
            if corner
                count += 1
        if count < 3
            return 0
        return if kick_test == 5 or (corners[position.state] and corners[(position.state + 1) % 4]) then 2 else 1

    SearchNode[] reachable(string kind, Position beginning)
        if not fits(kind, beginning)
            return []
        nodes := [SearchNode(beginning, [])]
        map<string, bool> visited
        .visited.set("{beginning.state},{beginning.x},{beginning.y}", true)
        nat cursor := 0
        while cursor < #nodes
            node := nodes[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for operation := ["L", "R", "LL", "RR", "SD", "DD", "CW", "CCW"][]
                Motion motion := movement(kind, node.position, operation)
                if not motion.success
                    continue
                target := motion.position
                key := "{target.state},{target.x},{target.y}"
                match visited.get(key)
                    bool found
                        continue
                    none
                        .visited.set(key, true)
                        nodes = nodes.append(SearchNode(target, node.operations.append(operation)))
        return nodes

    string[] | none shortest(string kind, Position target)
        for node := reachable(kind, spawn_position(kind))[]
            if landing(kind, node.position) == target
                return node.operations
        return none

    Candidate[] candidates(string kind, Position beginning, string[] prefix)
        Candidate[] result := []
        string[] seen := []
        string[][] rotations := [[], ["CW"], ["CW", "CW"], ["CCW"]]
        for sequence := rotations[]
            rotated := beginning
            valid := true
            for operation := sequence[]
                Motion motion := movement(kind, rotated, operation)
                if not motion.success
                    valid = false
                    break
                rotated = motion.position
            if not valid
                continue
            horizontal := [SearchNode(rotated, [])]
            for direction := ["L", "R"][]
                current := rotated
                string[] moves := []
                while true
                    Motion motion := movement(kind, current, direction)
                    if not motion.success
                        break
                    current = motion.position
                    moves = moves.append(direction)
                    horizontal = horizontal.append(SearchNode(current, moves))
            for node := horizontal[]
                Position target := landing(kind, node.position)
                occupied := [for cell := cells(kind, target)[] then cell.y * 10 + cell.x]
                key := [for cell := occupied.sorted()[] then string(cell)].join(",")
                if includes(seen, key)
                    continue
                seen = seen.append(key)
                placed := Well()
                placed.rows = rows
                cleared := .placed.place(kind, target)
                result = result.append(Candidate(placed.evaluation(cleared), kind, prefix.concat(sequence).concat(node.operations).append("HD")))
        return result

class State()
    well := Well()
    random_value := 1
    string[] queue := []
    hold := "-"
    hold_used := false
    kind := "I"
    position := Position()
    last_motion := 0
    last_test := 0
    keys := 0
    drop_points := 0
    fall := 0
    ground := 0
    resets := 0
    lowest_record := 0
    starting_level := 1
    level := 1
    score := 0
    lines := 0
    pieces := 0
    streak := 0
    chain := 0
    int[] pending := []
    stats := array(10, fill = 0)
    kind_counts := array(7, fill = 0)
    clear_counts := array(11, fill = 0)
    ended := false

    int .draw_random()
        random_value = random_value * 48271 % 2147483647
        return random_value

    void .bag()
        bag_values := ["I", "O", "T", "S", "Z", "J", "L"]
        for: 6 >= i >= 1
            int j := .draw_random() % (i + 1)
            saved := bag_values[i]
            bag_values[i] = bag_values[j]
            bag_values[j] = saved
        queue = queue.concat(bag_values)

    string .take()
        result := queue[0]
        queue = queue[1:]
        if #queue < 5
            .bag()
        return result

    void .spawn(string next_kind)
        kind = next_kind
        position = spawn_position(kind)
        last_motion = 0
        last_test = 0
        keys = 0
        drop_points = 0
        fall = 0
        ground = 0
        resets = 0
        lowest_record = lowest(kind, position)

    void .update(Position target, int motion, kick_test := 0)
        position = target
        last_motion = motion
        last_test = kick_test
        lowest_now := lowest(kind, target)
        if lowest_now < lowest_record
            lowest_record = lowest_now
            resets = 0

    Candidate[] ranked()
        Candidate[] result := well.candidates(kind, position, [])
        held_kind := if hold == "-" then queue[0] else hold
        if not hold_used and well.fits(held_kind, spawn_position(held_kind))
            result = result.concat(well.candidates(held_kind, spawn_position(held_kind), ["HOLD"]))
        for: 1 <= i < #result
            candidate := result[i]
            j := i
            while j > 0 and result[j - 1].value < candidate.value
                result[j] = result[j - 1]
                j -= 1
            result[j] = candidate
        return result

class Snapshot(State state, State piece_start, State[] history)

class Game()
    serial := 0
    started := false
    state := State()
    piece_start := State()
    State[] history := []
    saves := map<string, Snapshot>()

    void summary()
        emit("summary game {serial} score {state.score} level {state.level} lines {state.lines} pieces {state.pieces}")
        int[] clears := state.clear_counts
        int[] stats := state.stats
        emit("clears single {clears[0]} double {clears[1]} triple {clears[2]} tetris {clears[3]} perfect {stats[4]}")
        emit("tspins mini {clears[4]} mini_single {clears[5]} mini_double {clears[6]} zero {clears[7]} single {clears[8]} double {clears[9]} triple {clears[10]}")
        kinds := ["I", "O", "T", "S", "Z", "J", "L"]
        counts := [for i := (nat(0):<7)[] then kinds[i] + " {state.kind_counts[i]}"]
        emit("pieces " + counts.join(" "))
        emit("best combo {stats[8]} chain {stats[9]} holds {stats[1]} drops {stats[0]} faults {stats[3]}")
        emit("garbage sent {stats[5]} cancelled {stats[6]} received {stats[7]}")
        emit("rates app " + ratio(stats[5], state.pieces) + " apl " + ratio(stats[5], state.lines) + " kpp " + ratio(stats[2], state.pieces))

    void .game_over(string reason)
        emit("game over " + reason)
        summary()
        state.ended = true

    void .spawn_next(bool record_start)
        string next_kind := .state.take()
        .state.spawn(next_kind)
        if not state.well.fits(state.kind, state.position)
            .game_over("block out")
        elif record_start
            piece_start = state

    void .lock()
        Position position := state.position
        string kind := state.kind
        string[] shortest_moves := []
        shortest_exists := false
        match state.well.shortest(kind, position)
            string[] sequence
                shortest_exists = true
                shortest_moves = sequence
            none
                void
        int spin := if kind == "T" and state.last_motion == 2 then state.well.spin(position, state.last_test) else 0
        int cleared := .state.well.place(kind, position)
        history = history.append(piece_start)
        state.pieces += 1
        kind_index := 0
        while "IOTSZJL"[kind_index] != kind
            kind_index += 1
        state.kind_counts[kind_index] += 1
        state.stats[2] += state.keys
        clear_type := clear_index(spin, cleared)
        base_points := [100, 300, 500, 800, 100, 200, 400, 400, 800, 1200, 1600]
        base_send := [0, 1, 2, 4, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, 4, 6]
        int points := if clear_type < 0 then 0 else base_points[clear_type] * state.level
        send := if clear_type < 0 then 0 else base_send[clear_type]
        b2b := false
        if cleared > 0
            state.streak += 1
            if cleared == 4 or spin > 0
                state.chain += 1
                b2b = state.chain >= 2
            else
                state.chain = 0
        else
            state.streak = 0
        if b2b
            points = points * 3 / 2
            send += 1
        int combo := state.streak - 1
        int combo_points := if combo >= 1 then 50 * combo * state.level else 0
        if combo >= 0
            send += [0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5][minimum(combo, 10)]
        perfect := cleared > 0 and state.well.empty()
        perfect_points := 0
        if perfect
            perfect_points = (if cleared == 4 and b2b then 3200 else [800, 1200, 1800, 2000][cleared - 1]) * state.level
            send += 10
            state.stats[4] += 1
        gained := points + combo_points + perfect_points
        state.score += gained
        state.lines += cleared
        state.stats[5] += send
        state.stats[8] = maximum(state.stats[8], combo)
        state.stats[9] = maximum(state.stats[9], state.chain)
        shortest_word := if shortest_exists then string(#shortest_moves) else "-"
        emit("lock {state.pieces} {kind} " + state_name(position.state) + " {position.x} {position.y} keys {state.keys} {shortest_word} drop {state.drop_points} lines {cleared} sent {send} +{gained} total {state.score}")
        if shortest_exists and state.keys > int(#shortest_moves)
            state.stats[3] += 1
            emit("finesse " + (if #shortest_moves == 0 then "none" else shortest_moves.join(" ")))
        if clear_type >= 0
            state.clear_counts[clear_type] += 1
            output := "clear " + clear_name(clear_type) + " {points}"
            if b2b
                output += " b2b"
            if combo >= 1
                output += " combo {combo} {combo_points}"
            if perfect
                output += " perfect {perfect_points}"
            emit(output)
        int next_level := state.starting_level + state.lines / 10
        if next_level > state.level
            state.level = next_level
            emit("level {next_level}")
        if lowest(kind, position) >= 21
            .game_over("lock out")
            return
        cancelled := minimum(send, total(state.pending))
        if cancelled > 0
            remaining := cancelled
            while remaining > 0
                amount := minimum(remaining, state.pending[0])
                state.pending[0] -= amount
                remaining -= amount
                if state.pending[0] == 0
                    state.pending = state.pending[1:]
            state.stats[6] += cancelled
            emit("cancel {cancelled} pending {total(state.pending)}")
        if cleared == 0
            risen := 0
            while #state.pending > 0 and risen < 8
                amount := minimum(state.pending[0], 8 - risen)
                int hole := .state.draw_random() % 10 + 1
                if not .state.well.garbage(amount, hole)
                    .game_over("top out")
                    return
                state.stats[7] += amount
                risen += amount
                state.pending[0] -= amount
                if state.pending[0] == 0
                    state.pending = state.pending[1:]
                emit("rise {amount} hole {hole} pending {total(state.pending)}")
        state.hold_used = false
        .spawn_next(true)

    void .operation(string operation_name)
        if operation_name == "HD"
            Position target := state.well.landing(state.kind, state.position)
            int distance := state.position.y - target.y
            state.score += 2 * distance
            state.drop_points += 2 * distance
            state.stats[0] += 2 * distance
            if distance > 0
                .state.update(target, 1)
            .lock()
        elif operation_name == "LOCK"
            if state.well.grounded(state.kind, state.position)
                .lock()
            else
                emit("fail LOCK")
        elif operation_name == "HOLD"
            if state.hold_used
                emit("fail HOLD")
                return
            state.hold_used = true
            state.stats[1] += 1
            string held := state.hold
            state.hold = state.kind
            if held == "-"
                .spawn_next(false)
            else
                .state.spawn(held)
                if not state.well.fits(state.kind, state.position)
                    .game_over("block out")
        else
            state.keys += 1
            Motion motion := state.well.movement(state.kind, state.position, operation_name)
            if not motion.success
                emit("fail " + operation_name)
                return
            drop := operation_name == "SD" or operation_name == "DD"
            if drop
                int distance := state.position.y - motion.position.y
                state.score += distance
                state.drop_points += distance
                state.stats[0] += distance
            .state.update(motion.position, if motion.kick_test > 0 then 2 else 1, motion.kick_test)
            if drop
                state.fall = 0
                state.ground = 0
            elif state.ground > 0 and state.resets < 15
                state.ground = 0
                state.resets += 1

    void spins()
        if state.kind != "T"
            emit("spins 0")
            return
        Position[] positions := []
        int[] classifications := []
        for node := state.well.reachable("T", state.position)[]
            for rotation := ["CW", "CCW"][]
                Motion motion := state.well.movement("T", node.position, rotation)
                if not motion.success or not state.well.grounded("T", motion.position)
                    continue
                int spin := state.well.spin(motion.position, motion.kick_test)
                if spin == 0
                    continue
                found := -1
                for: i < #positions
                    if positions[i] == motion.position
                        found = int(i)
                if found < 0
                    positions = positions.append(motion.position)
                    classifications = classifications.append(spin)
                else
                    classifications[found] = maximum(classifications[found], spin)
        keys := [for position := positions[] then (position.y + 5) * 100 + (position.x + 5) * 4 + position.state]
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            for: i < #keys
                if keys[i] != key
                    continue
                position := positions[i]
                Well placed := state.well
                cleared := .placed.place("T", position)
                emit("spin " + state_name(position.state) + " {position.x} {position.y} " + clear_name(clear_index(classifications[i], cleared)))
        emit("spins {#positions}")

    void .execute(string[] words)
        command := words[0]
        commands := ["NEW", "PRINT", "NEXT", "PREVIEW", "STATUS", "ANALYZE", "ROW", "GARBAGE", "ATTACK", "TICK", "UNDO", "SAVE", "LOAD", "SPINS", "HINT", "AUTO"]
        operations := ["L", "R", "LL", "RR", "SD", "DD", "CW", "CCW", "HD", "LOCK", "HOLD"]
        if not includes(commands, command)
            for item := words[]
                if not includes(operations, item)
                    emit("ERROR unknown " + item)
                    return
            if not started
                emit("ERROR no game")
            elif state.ended
                emit("ERROR game over")
            else
                for item := words[]
                    .operation(item)
                    if state.ended
                        break
            return
        args := words[1:]
        valid := true
        first := -1
        second := -1
        if command == "NEW" or command == "GARBAGE" or command == "ROW"
            valid = #args == 2
            if valid
                first = numeric(args[0], 1, if command == "NEW" then 2147483646 elif command == "GARBAGE" then 10 else 22)
                valid = first >= 0
                if command == "ROW"
                    valid = valid and #args[1] == 10 and args[1].contains(".")
                    for: i < #args[1]
                        valid = valid and "#.".contains(args[1][i])
                else
                    second = numeric(args[1], 1, if command == "NEW" then 15 else 10)
                    valid = valid and second >= 0
        elif includes(["PREVIEW", "ATTACK", "TICK", "HINT", "AUTO"], command)
            valid = #args == 1
            if valid
                high := if command == "PREVIEW" then 14 elif command == "ATTACK" then 20 elif command == "TICK" then 1000 elif command == "HINT" then 10 else 50
                first = numeric(args[0], 1, high)
                valid = first >= 0
        elif command == "SAVE" or command == "LOAD"
            valid = #args == 1
            if valid
                valid = #args[0] >= 1 and #args[0] <= 8
                for: i < #args[0]
                    valid = valid and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(args[0][i])
        else
            valid = #args == 0
        if not valid
            emit("ERROR bad arguments")
            return
        if command != "NEW" and not started
            emit("ERROR no game")
            return
        if command != "NEW" and state.ended and not includes(["PRINT", "NEXT", "PREVIEW", "STATUS", "ANALYZE", "LOAD"], command)
            emit("ERROR game over")
            return
        if command == "NEW"
            if started and not state.ended
                emit("game stopped")
                summary()
            serial += 1
            started = true
            state = State()
            state.random_value = first
            state.starting_level = second
            state.level = second
            history = []
            saves = map<string, Snapshot>()
            emit("game {serial} seed {first} level {second}")
            .state.bag()
            .spawn_next(true)
        elif command == "PRINT"
            Point[] active := if state.ended then [] else cells(state.kind, state.position)
            Point[] ghost := if state.ended then [] else cells(state.kind, state.well.landing(state.kind, state.position))
            for: 22 >= row >= 1
                text := (if row < 10 then " " else "") + string(row) + " "
                for: 1 <= column <= 10
                    cell := Point(column, row)
                    text += if state.well.rows[row - 1][column - 1] then "#" elif includes(active, cell) then "@" elif includes(ghost, cell) then "+" else "."
                emit(text)
        elif command == "NEXT"
            emit("hold {state.hold} next " + state.queue[:<5].join(""))
        elif command == "PREVIEW"
            State preview := state
            while int(#preview.queue) < first
                .preview.bag()
            emit("preview " + preview.queue[:<first].join(""))
        elif command == "STATUS"
            emit("score {state.score} level {state.level} lines {state.lines} pieces {state.pieces}")
            string piece := if state.ended then "-" else state.kind + " " + state_name(state.position.state) + " {state.position.x} {state.position.y}"
            emit("piece {piece} streak {state.streak} chain {state.chain} pending {total(state.pending)}")
        elif command == "ANALYZE"
            int[] measurements := state.well.metrics()
            emit("heights " + [for height := measurements[:<10][] then string(height)].join(" "))
            emit("holes {measurements[10]} bumpiness {measurements[11]} value {state.well.evaluation(0)}")
        elif command == "ROW"
            for cell := cells(state.kind, state.position)[]
                if cell.y == first and args[1][cell.x - 1] == "#"
                    emit("ERROR overlap")
                    return
            state.well.rows[first - 1] = [for i := (nat(0):<10)[] then args[1][i] == "#"]
            emit("OK")
        elif command == "GARBAGE"
            if not .state.well.garbage(first, second)
                .game_over("top out")
                return
            for: rise <= first
                target := Position(state.position.state, state.position.x, state.position.y + rise)
                if state.well.fits(state.kind, target)
                    state.position = target
                    emit("OK")
                    return
            .game_over("top out")
        elif command == "ATTACK"
            state.pending = state.pending.append(first)
            emit("pending {total(state.pending)}")
        elif command == "TICK"
            for: tick < first
                if not state.well.grounded(state.kind, state.position)
                    state.ground = 0
                    state.fall += 1
                    interval := if state.level >= 13 then 1 else [60, 48, 37, 28, 21, 16, 11, 8, 6, 4, 3, 2][state.level - 1]
                    if state.fall >= interval
                        .state.update(Position(state.position.state, state.position.x, state.position.y - 1), 1)
                        state.fall = 0
                else
                    state.ground += 1
                    if state.ground >= 30
                        .lock()
                if state.ended
                    break
        elif command == "UNDO"
            if #history == 0
                emit("ERROR nothing to undo")
            else
                state = history[-1]
                history = history[:<#history - 1]
                piece_start = state
                emit("undo {state.pieces} {state.kind}")
        elif command == "SAVE"
            .saves.set(args[0], Snapshot(state, piece_start, history))
            emit("OK")
        elif command == "LOAD"
            match saves.get(args[0])
                Snapshot saved
                    state = saved.state
                    piece_start = saved.piece_start
                    history = saved.history
                    emit("load {state.pieces} {state.kind}")
                none
                    emit("ERROR unknown save")
        elif command == "SPINS"
            spins()
        elif command == "HINT"
            Candidate[] candidates := state.ranked()
            for: i < minimum(first, int(#candidates))
                candidate := candidates[i]
                emit("hint {i + 1} {candidate.kind} " + candidate.operations.join(" ") + " value {candidate.value}")
        else
            for: i < first
                Candidate candidate := state.ranked()[0]
                emit("auto {candidate.kind} " + candidate.operations.join(" "))
                for item := candidate.operations[]
                    .operation(item)
                    if state.ended
                        break
                if state.ended
                    break

void run_commands()
    game := Game()
    nat count := 0
    scan(&count)
    for: i < count
        line := ""
        scan(&line)
        .game.execute(line.split(" "))
    if game.started and not game.state.ended
        emit("game stopped")
        game.summary()

run_commands()
